title: The middleman has 10,000 followers
scenario: You are trading a rare in-game item. The other player suggests a “trusted middleman” with a huge following who will hold both items. The middleman sends a trade link outside the game.

answers.A: Use the game/platform’s official trading system and avoid off-platform middlemen.
answers.B: Check whether the game recognizes any escrow or trade-protection system before proceeding.
answers.C: Use the middleman because the follower count and public reputation make a scam unlikely.

explanation: Follower counts and reputation accounts can be bought or hijacked. The strongest protection is the platform’s own transaction control.
proTip: Trade protection should come from the system, not a celebrity stranger.
